triples.tail_surface: Fill pump with liquid before start up
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: Dry run is not allowed. Fill pump with liquid before start up.

triples.tail_surface: A cos  measuring device can be fitted to the power circuit and set to trip the drive power in case of the power consumption being too low
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装功率因数测量装置并在功耗过低时切断驱动电源
triples.evidence_text: Dry run is not allowed. Fill pump with liquid before start up. A cos  measuring device can be fitted to the power circuit and set to trip the drive power in case of the power consumption being too low.

triples.tail_surface: frictional heat being developed causing critical high temperatures at seal faces
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 摩擦生热导致密封面临界高温
triples.evidence_text: Dry run will result in frictional heat being developed causing critical high temperatures at seal faces.

triples.tail_surface: A pressure switch can be fitted to trip the drive power in case of the outlet pressure being too high
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装压力开关并在出口压力过高时切断驱动电源
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: Pumping against closed outlet valve is not allowed for more than 2 minutes. A pressure switch can be fitted to trip the drive power in case of the outlet pressure being too high.

triples.head_surface: Choking or clogging of the pump
triples.tail_surface: too low load or overload of the motor or bending of the shaft
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 电机欠载或过载或轴弯曲
triples.evidence_text: Choking or clogging of the pump can result in either too low load or overload of the motor or bending of the shaft.

triples.head_surface: Choking or clogging of the pump
triples.tail_surface: Use a strainer / filter in the suction pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在吸入管路使用滤器/过滤器
triples.evidence_text: Choking or clogging of the pump can result in either too low load or overload of the motor or bending of the shaft. Use a strainer / filter in the suction pipe.

triples.head_surface: Choking or clogging of the pump
triples.tail_surface: A cos  measuring device can be fitted to the power circuit and set to trip the drive power in case of power consumption being too low or too high
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装功率因数测量装置并在功耗过低或过高时切断驱动电源
triples.evidence_text: Use a strainer / filter in the suction pipe. A cos  measuring device can be fitted to the power circuit and set to trip the drive power in case of power consumption being too low or too high.

triples.tail_surface: The termistors (if any) in the electric motor can only be used to trip the drive power at overload
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 利用电机热敏电阻在过载时切断驱动电源
triples.evidence_text: The termistors (if any) in the electric motor can only be used to trip the drive power at overload.

triples.tail_surface: replenish grease according to instruction manuals
triples.evidence_text: User must replenish grease according to instruction manuals and replace bearings after 90% of rated life i.e. 22500 hours.

triples.tail_surface: replace bearings after 90% of rated life i.e. 22500 hours
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在额定寿命90%（即22500小时）后更换轴承
triples.evidence_text: User must replenish grease according to instruction manuals and replace bearings after 90% of rated life i.e. 22500 hours.
The bearing housing is fitted with a temperature sensor (or two in Spacer pumps) to be connected to the electrical control system on site.

triples.tail_surface: Set the system to trip the drive power 10°C above normal operating temperature
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设定系统在高于正常运行温度10°C时切断驱动电源
triples.evidence_text: The bearing housing is fitted with a temperature sensor (or two in Spacer pumps) to be connected to the electrical control system on site. Set the system to trip the drive power 10°C above normal operating temperature.
